svg.title: GimDrone: a quadcopter inside a gimballed cage, props spinning
svg.text: hackPHS 2026. A search-and-rescue FPV drone built to take
the crash instead of trying to avoid it. Our first hardware hack.
3D printed PETG, reinforced with carbon fiber
Betaflight, ExpressLRS and the video transmitter on one board
the cage rolls off a wall while the drone stays level
a Raspberry Pi tracks AprilTags and steers through an ESP32-S3
